guides.name: Getting Started
guides.contents:
# Getting Started

How to call the Giddh API from your app or integration.

## Base URL

`https://api.giddh.com`

## Authentication

Every company-scoped request needs one of:

| Header | When to use |
| --- | --- |
| `Auth-Key` | Server integrations / API keys |
| `Session-Id` | Logged-in Giddh panel session |

Many routes also require `companyUniqueName` in the path.

## Voucher version

Accounting microservice voucher APIs (generate, get-all, adjust, recurring, business documents) expect:

`voucherVersion=2`

This matches the Giddh panel. Without it you may see `INVALID_PARAMETERS` or missing entry-date errors.

## Recommended reading order

1. **Auth** — login, keys, sessions
2. **Company** / **Branch** — tenant context
3. **Account** / **Group** — chart of accounts
4. **Voucher** / **Business Documents** / **Invoice** — sales & purchase documents
5. **Ledger** — account books
6. **Inventory** / **Stock** — items and warehouses
7. **Banking** / **Payment** — money movement
8. **GST** / **E-Invoice** / **E-Way Bill** — India compliance
9. **Reports** / **Dashboard** — analytics

Open each topic under [API Guides](/p/api-guides?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx), then use **API Reference** for schemas.

## Proforma & Estimation

- [Estimation guide](/p/estimation?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)
- [Proforma guide](/p/proforma?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx)

## Full module list

See [API Guides](/p/api-guides?collectionId=-Jey39dCAAyx) and the Guides sidebar for every module.
